_doc: Hand-written per-sentence direction for the Ming study (notes/32). Shape: passage -> segment (as in segments.json) -> sentence (as in its sentences ranges) -> emotion, or [emotion, tagged text]. Emotions are the contract names (happy sad angry fearful disgusted surprised neutral). A tagged text replaces the sentence and carries Ming paralinguistic tags; it is rendered with the TTS task (reference + transcript), which has no emotion control, so its emotion is intent only.
